messages:
jordan: Heads up — noticed a spike in "route match flapping" alerts for the /v1/generate route since 03:10 UTC. Appears to flip between matcher=A and matcher=B for same tenant header within seconds. Any ideas? :thinking:
vikram: oof. Is this the prefiler or the prioritizer? can you paste the raw headers from a captured request?
maria: also saw higher error budget usage in the last 30m, maybe related. flapping makes sampling fragile.
jordan: here's one example from the proxy logs (redacted tenant id). request_id=rid_9a2c
```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.internal
x-tenant-id: tenant-42
x-feature-rollout: beta
user-agent: Redwood-CLI/1.3
x-route-hash: ab12
```
log excerpt:
```
2026-03-18T03:11:02Z route-eval: matcher=A matched by header x-tenant-id=tenant-42 (score=0.82)
2026-03-18T03:11:02Z sampler: sampled=false (rate=0.01)
2026-03-18T03:11:03Z route-eval: matcher=B matched by header x-tenant-id=tenant-42 (score=0.79)
```
jordan: main weirdness is two different matchers both claiming to match the exact same header set in ~1s window. sampling also shows inconsistent correlator ids.
vikram: could be header normalization race — are we normalizing header casing in the gateway before rule evaluation? I know there was a fast-path change last week.
maria: we did change a prefilter for header canonicalization but it should be idempotent. maybe async cache expiry makes it read stale rules? :grimacing:
sre-lisa: can we repro with a curl loop from inside staging? if it's non-deterministic we should enable full decision logs for that tenant and turn off sampling temporarily.
jordan: good call. enabling full decision logs now for tenant-42 between 03:10-03:20 via console. also bumped sample rate to 100% on eval-trace for that tenant.
ops-bot: action taken: decision-logs=FULL for tenant=tenant-42 (expiring 2026-03-18T04:00Z). sampling_override=1.00. ticket=ENGPLAT-4721
vikram: thanks. while that's running, can you dump the route matcher definitions? specifically any regex vs header-equals mix.
jordan: route matcher snippets (from configured ruleset):
```
- matcher: A
  match:
    headers:
      - name: x-tenant-id
        op: equals
        value: "tenant-42"
    priority: 100
- matcher: B
  match:
    headers:
      - name: x-tenant-id
        op: regex
        value: "tenant-4.*"
    priority: 90
```
maria: ah — regex vs equals with different priority could cause overlap. But flapping suggests sometimes matcher B wins even with lower priority.
vikram: priorities are numeric; higher wins. are priorities stable? could we have a tiebreaker based on insertion order that got changed when ruleset rolled out? last rollout tried to reindex rules.
jordan: rollout history shows a ruleset reindex at 03:05 that touched matcher ordering. maybe some nodes saw old index while others had new index.
sre-lisa: that would explain per-node nondeterminism. need to ensure atomic swap for ruleset id across the fleet.
maria: for short-term mitigation, increase matcher A priority to 200 or make equals check more specific. long-term: make ruleset apply via versioned mount + atomic pointer.
vikram: agree. also decision logs show correlator flipping — looks like some gateway nodes still using old sampler correlator seed causing different sample decisions. ops-bot's sampling override should unify that.
ops-bot: note: sampling_override=1.00 applied to eval-trace route for tenant-42 on nodes with tag=stable-123. Nodes without tag will fall back.
jordan: running a curl loop against a small fleet subset now (10 reqs/s for 2 minutes) to validate.

[10m later]

jordan: update — after sampling override and enabling FULL logs, we saw the flapping stop for nodes with updated ruleset. two nodes still flapped: node-7 (old index) and node-12 (old sampler). both are on the older image.
vikram: can we cordon node-7 and drain? schedule a restart for node-12 to pick up new sampler lib.
sre-lisa: cordon+drain node-7 done. restart of node-12 scheduled, ETA 03:45.
maria: add a console alert to detect any ruleset id drift across active nodes — simple diff of active_ruleset_id per node every 30s.
jordan: agreed. I created ENGPLAT-4722 to add ruleset-id heartbeat and a one-off dashboard panel. assigned to @vikram.
vikram: I'll take it. quick follow-ups: 1) patch the rollout to be atomic (k8s ConfigMap switch) 2) add a migration that converts regex overlaps to explicit precedence warnings during validation 3) ensure header canonicalization runs before sampler and matcher.
jordan: thanks all. postmortem next if this reoccurs. for now the incident is mitigated: flapping reduced to 0 across prod after node restarts. :white_check_mark:
